title: The broken vase
setup_text: A favourite vase is in three pieces on the kitchen floor, and Mia is standing very still beside it.

choices.label: Clean it up together
choices.outcome_text: You swept it up side by side. The vase is gone; the afternoon is not.

choices.label: Ask what happened first
choices.outcome_text: She told you the whole story twice. Nobody was cross by the end of it.

choices.label: Put it on the high shelf and move on
choices.outcome_text: The shelf is safer now. She watched you do it without a word.

title: A pet, probably
setup_text: Mia has drawn a dog and taped it to the fridge with your name on it.

choices.label: Say yes to a small fish
choices.outcome_text: The fish is called Biscuit. The bowl is cleaned every Sunday without being asked.

choices.label: Say not yet, and mean it
choices.outcome_text: You made a list of what a dog would need. The list is long. She reads it anyway.

title: The first morning
setup_text: The shoes are too shiny and the gate is too big, and Mia has gone quiet.

choices.label: Walk her to the door
choices.outcome_text: You got as far as the door. She went in on her own feet.

choices.label: Wait at the gate
choices.outcome_text: She turned round twice to check you were there. You were.

title: Pocket money
setup_text: There is a jar on the counter and a long, careful list of things Mia wants to buy.

choices.label: Three coins a week, no questions
choices.outcome_text: The jar fills slowly. She counts it every Friday and tells nobody the total.

choices.label: Three coins, and a job for more
choices.outcome_text: The windows are streaky and she is very proud of them.

choices.label: Save up for something together
choices.outcome_text: You are both saving for the same thing. She checks the jar more than you do.

title: The empty seat
setup_text: A friend has stopped sitting next to Mia at lunch, and she is not sure why.

choices.label: Practise what to say
choices.outcome_text: She said it badly and it worked anyway. The seat is taken again.

choices.label: Let her sit with someone else
choices.outcome_text: There is a new seat at a new table. It took a fortnight to feel normal.

title: The second tree
setup_text: Mia has a line in the school play and a bad case of the nerves.

choices.label: Rehearse in the kitchen
choices.outcome_text: She knows it backwards by Thursday. On the night, you mouth every word with her.

choices.label: Tell her it is fine to be nervous
choices.outcome_text: She was nervous and she did it anyway. That is the bit she remembers.

title: The kitchen light
setup_text: It is late, and Mia is sitting at the kitchen table with something she has been carrying all week.

choices.label: Stay up and listen
choices.outcome_text: You heard all of it, even the parts that were hard to hear. She slept better than you did.

choices.label: Say it can wait until morning
choices.outcome_text: In the morning it had shrunk to a shrug. You both let it go.

title: The map on the wall
setup_text: There is a map on Mia's wall with three cities circled, and none of them are near.

choices.label: Help her plan the first one
choices.outcome_text: The plan is on the fridge in her handwriting. You have never been so proud of a bus timetable.

choices.label: Ask her to show you the map
choices.outcome_text: She explained every circle. You asked questions until it got late.

choices.label: Say you will miss her
choices.outcome_text: She rolled her eyes and hugged you. The map stayed up.
